purpose: Polar exact-128M LR spot-check around champion LR 0.05

ledger_repair.reason: This ledger was written when the lr=0.025 job started and was never updated again. It recorded that job as 'running' and omitted lr=0.035, 0.07 and 0.1 entirely, although all four completed on 2026-07-16. The job list below was reconstructed from the run directories on disk; every validation_bpb is the final_ema_sliding_bpb on the last line of that run's metrics.jsonl.

jobs.note: This is the funnel champion's selected LR, tuned at arch02-16m.

finding.summary: At exact-128M the LR optimum sits near 0.035, not at the champion's 0.05. The curve is U-shaped with a single interior minimum: 0.025 -> 2.366180, 0.035 -> 2.359962, 0.05 -> 2.420958, 0.07 -> 2.512071, 0.1 -> 2.686179.
finding.champion_lr_penalty_definition: validation_bpb(lr=0.05) - validation_bpb(lr=0.035), both at 128M / 500 steps / seed 1337.
finding.selection_margin_definition: mean validation_bpb of normuon_adamw (2.201145) minus muon_polar_adamw (2.1699185) at exact_128m_1000, seeds 42 and 2026.
finding.why_this_matters: The champion's LR mis-tuning penalty is 1.95x the margin by which it was selected. The champion LR was tuned at arch02-16m and never re-tuned at 128M; normuon_adamw's lr 0.1 was likewise never re-tuned. Neither finalist was tuned at the scale where the selection was made, so the ordering between them is not established by this evidence.
finding.lr_conditional_reversal: muon_polar_adamw at lr 0.1 scores 2.686179, which is worse than normuon_adamw's 2.567474 at the same 128M / 500-step protocol. The Polar-vs-NorMuon ordering is therefore LR-conditional within the range swept here.
finding.limits: n=1 per LR point, 500 steps, seed 1337 only. normuon_adamw has no matching LR spot-check. This is a threat to the validity of the selection, not a refutation of it. Closing it requires the Polar and NorMuon LR grids at 1000 steps on seeds 42 and 2026.
